title: Into the Thornwood
description: Twelve Aldenmoor scouts entered the Thornwood three nights ago and haven't returned. Captain Voss needs answers — and she needs them kept quiet.

objectives.text: Find the missing scouts in the Thornwood
Return to Seraphina with your findings

title: Debt Collector
description: The Ironveil Syndicate claims a local farmer owes back payments on a loan he never took. Rough up enough locals and someone might start asking questions.

objectives.text: Intercept the syndicate collector before he reaches the farm
Find evidence of the forged loan documents

title: The Root Remembers
description: An ancient grove near the village is dying — but the Wandering Circle believes something is being deliberately poisoned into the soil. Mara suspects the Syndicate.

objectives.text: Collect soil samples from the dying grove
Bring the samples to Mara for analysis
